body:
Milestone 9 (`project-pages`): three more project home pages get a figure from their own output.

- `sequential-slashing`: mean detection delay vs alpha against the Wald bound (log x).
- `stale-rollouts`: effective samples left in a 1000-sample batch vs lag.
- `robust-aggregation`: worst-case median bias vs Byzantine fraction.

Each `experiments/figure.py` parses the committed `results.txt`; no numbers retyped, no experiment re-run. `python3 site/build.py` → `ok: 463 projects, 4059 tests`. PROJECTS.md progress note updated.

Note: oss-monorepo#7243 (cutover) is open and its first comment says upstream is ahead of its pinned sync point; this PR will also need a mirror sync if it lands before cutover.
